text:
maria: morning! first day. running into a few annoying bootstrap issues on my M2 Mac. asdf-installed python keeps saying 'shim not found' after I installed 3.11. poetry install fails with "command not found: python". also brew is in /opt/homebrew but terminal doesn't pick it up. docker devcontainer can't access /var/run/docker.sock (permission denied). who should I ping for quick help?

sanjay: hey! 🖐️ 2 quick things to try: make sure brew is on your PATH and re-eval shell env: `echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile && eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"`. then inside your shell run `asdf reshim python` and restart the shell. check `which python` and `asdf current python`. if you're on fish replace zprofile with config.fish commands.

aisha: also double-check ~/.tool-versions — if the repo uses direnv/devcontainer sometimes asdf isn't picked up. if you use direnv add `use asdf` to your .envrc. for poetry: `poetry env use $(asdf which python)` or set `poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true` so it doesn't look for global python.

devon: for the docker socket error — on mac we usually run Docker Desktop. devcontainer trying to mount the host socket will fail if Docker Desktop isn't running or if you're using colima/nerdctl. quick debug: on host `ls -l /var/run/docker.sock` and `docker ps`. if using Docker Desktop, try restarting it. Avoid `sudo chown` unless temporary; instead ensure devcontainer.json has the correct mount. Example snippet:

```
"mounts": [
  "source=/var/run/docker.sock,target=/var/run/docker.sock,type=bind"
]
```

maria: ok reshim fixed the python/shim problem, and brew shellenv fixed brew path. thanks!! docker socket still 403/permission denied when devcontainer tries to build.

sanjay: if you're on Colima, the socket path can be different (e.g. /var/run/colima/docker.sock). run `colima status` or `docker context ls`. also check whether the container runtime inside the devcontainer expects root. sometimes adding this to devcontainer.json helps: `"runArgs": ["--privileged"]` (not ideal but ok for local).

aisha: one more: add your ssh key to the mac keychain so git hooks that call CI scripts can access credentials: `ssh-add --apple-load-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `git config --global core.hooksPath .githooks` if repo uses in-repo hooks.

devon: if you want I can hop on a quick call. ping me with your timezone. also @maria, add yourself to the dev Slack alias `dev-oncall` for infra perms so we can grant any extra Docker group access.

onboard-bot: welcome @maria :tada: — onboarding checklist is here: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/dev-setup (brew/asdf/direnv/ssh/1password steps). if you'd like an onboarding buddy, reply with 2 time slots and we'll pair you up.

maria: sweet, thanks all — got most things working. i'll push a short PR with dotfiles tweaks + a note in the repo README about the devcontainer socket quirk. can someone review later? @sanjay?

sanjay: :thumbsup: i'll review this afternoon.

aisha: feel free to ping me if the poetry venv is weird, I can help clean it out.

maria: will do, appreciate it!
